faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: About PickMySaaS and how we work.

items.question: Who is PickMySaaS?
items.answer: A founder-led product studio run by Asfand Yar Khan, building websites, SaaS platforms and AI-first MVPs. Five years of shipping for clients worldwide, now focused on founders and businesses across the GCC.

items.question: Where are you based?
items.answer: We work remotely with clients worldwide, with a focus on the Gulf. Calls happen on video, WhatsApp or phone, in Arabic or English.

items.question: Do you only work with Gulf companies?
items.answer: No. The Gulf is our focus, but we work with clients anywhere.

items.question: What kind of clients do you work with?
items.answer: Founders validating an idea, SMEs that need a stronger web presence, and larger teams that need a product built fast.

items.question: Do you work in Arabic?
items.answer: Yes. We build fully bilingual products, and right-to-left layouts are standard, not an extra.

items.question: What does “AI-first” mean?
items.answer: AI is part of the product’s core from the first design, such as an assistant that answers your customers or a tool that reads documents for you. It isn’t bolted on later.

items.question: Can you take over an existing product?
items.answer: Usually, yes. We review it first and tell you honestly whether to improve it or rebuild.

items.question: How do we get started?
items.answer: Book a free 30-minute call or message us on WhatsApp. We’ll talk through your idea and send you a clear proposal.

meta.title: Services — Web Design, SaaS & AI MVP Development
meta.description: Bilingual websites from $500, SaaS platforms and AI-first MVPs for startups and businesses in the UAE, Saudi Arabia and across the GCC. A free first call, a clear proposal and a fixed price.

hero.description: Three ways to launch, one team: from a sharper website to a full software product, designed and built for the Gulf.

web.heading: Web design & development
paragraphs: Your website is often the first conversation a customer has with you. It needs to look credible, load fast and make the next step obvious.

We design and build bilingual websites in Arabic and English around your business and your customers. They go live within a week, with right-to-left layouts done properly and every page built to rank in Google and be understood by AI assistants. The domain and website are in your name: you own it.

included.text: shaped around your brand and the customers you want to reach.
full right-to-left layouts and Arabic type that reads beautifully.
pages that open instantly, even on mobile data.
SEO and AI-search readiness built in, measured with our own Snippet Tester.
WhatsApp, booking and enquiry forms placed where customers actually use them.

packages.heading: Simple, fixed prices
packages.lead: Pick what fits now. You can upgrade later.

items.name: Starter
items.for: For small businesses that need a professional site, fast.
features: Basic SEO and Google Maps link

items.name: Business
items.for: For businesses that need more pages, a custom design or an online store.
features: Online store, booking, menu or listings

items.name: Premium
items.for: For larger sites, bigger online stores and a fully custom design.
features: Up to 15 pages, fully custom premium design
Arabic and English copy written for you
Advanced store and integrations: CRM, booking, delivery

packages.note: Hosting and SSL are set up in every package. Extra pages and work beyond your package are quoted separately. Timelines count business days (Sunday to Thursday) from when we have your content. The domain renews yearly at cost.

saas.heading: SaaS products
paragraphs: A SaaS product is software your customers subscribe to and use online, from booking platforms and dashboards to marketplaces and internal tools.

We take you from idea to a working platform in 4 to 8 weeks, built in Python and Django, the framework behind Instagram. You get user accounts and roles, subscriptions and billing, admin dashboards and the integrations your business runs on, all built for Gulf customers, with local payment methods and GCC hosting when your sector requires it.

included.text: we help decide what to build first and what can wait.
everything a real SaaS needs to sign up customers and charge them.
connected to the payment methods your customers already use.

included.lead: Data where it needs to be
included.text: GCC hosting and data-protection requirements (PDPL) built in when your sector asks for them.
a clean architecture that scales from your first customer to your thousandth.

ai.heading: AI-first MVPs
paragraphs: An MVP (minimum viable product) is the smallest version of your idea that real users can try. It’s the fastest, cheapest way to find out if it works.

We build MVPs with AI at their core, in Python, the language modern AI is built in: assistants that answer customers in Arabic and English, tools that read and process documents, and automation that saves hours of manual work. You get a working product in 4 to 8 weeks, ready to show users and investors.

included.text: not slides or mock-ups, but something real people can use.
chatbots, document processing and automation built around your use case.
assistants and tools that understand and respond in Arabic and English.
a product you can demo, measure and build a pitch around.
when the MVP proves itself, it grows into a full product without starting over.

process.heading: How a project runs
process.lead: From your first call to a live product.

steps.title: Discover
steps.description: You book a free 30-minute call or message us on WhatsApp. We talk through the problem, your users and your deadline. No obligation.

steps.title: Scope
steps.description: You get one clear proposal: what we’ll build, when it’s ready and one fixed price. You decide with everything on the table.

steps.title: Build
steps.description: We work in short sprints with a demo every week, so you see your product take shape and can steer it.

steps.title: Launch & grow
steps.description: Your product goes live, with the domain and code in your name. Afterwards we stay reachable, and the monthly care plan keeps it updated, secure and growing.

faq.heading: Questions and answers
faq.lead: The things clients ask before we start.

items.question: What does a project cost?
items.answer: Websites have fixed package prices: Starter $500, Business $800, and Premium from $1,000. SaaS and AI projects get one fixed price in your proposal, agreed before we start. No hourly billing, no surprises.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: Websites go live in about a week. SaaS platforms and AI MVPs typically take 4 to 8 weeks. Your proposal names the exact timeline.

items.question: Do you build in Arabic?
items.answer: Yes. Bilingual Arabic and English is our default, not an add-on.

items.question: What happens to my current website?
items.answer: It stays online until the new one is ready. Your content, your domain and your Google rankings come with you.

items.question: Do we need to meet in person?
items.answer: No. Projects run by video, WhatsApp and email, and we work across Gulf time zones.

items.question: Who will I work with?
items.answer: Asfand, directly. PickMySaaS is founder-led: the person you talk to on the first call is the person who designs and builds your product. No account managers, no handoffs.

items.question: Is the product really mine?
items.answer: Yes. The domain is registered in your name and the code is handed over when the project is complete. Hosting can run on your own account, or we manage it for you under the care plan. Either way, you can take everything with you.

items.question: What’s in the care plan?
items.answer: A monthly plan that keeps your website or product updated, secure and backed up, with small changes included. Ask about it on the call.

items.question: Can I edit the website myself after launch?
items.answer: Yes, if you want to. Tell us on the first call and we’ll set it up for easy editing. Or send us your changes under the care plan.

items.question: Is there anything you don’t build?
items.answer: If it runs on the web, we build it: websites, online stores, SaaS platforms, dashboards, APIs and AI tools, all in Python and Django. What we don’t build is native iPhone or Android apps. Instead we build fast, mobile-friendly web apps that work on any phone, no app store needed.
